settings.title: Cashbook settings
settings.subtitle: Settings sirf is store par apply hoti hain.
settings.loading: Cashbook settings load ho rahi hain…
settings.loadFailed: Cashbook settings load nahi ho payi.
settings.autoInvoiceCashInHint: Invoices se receive cash payments automatically link karein. Unpaid invoices aur digital payments exclude hain.
settings.autoExpenseCashOutHint: Payment method Cash wale paid expenses automatically link karein.
settings.autoSalaryCashOutHint: Staff salary cash entries ko dusre expenses se alag control karein.
settings.automationNote: Yeh switches nayi automatic entries control karte hain. Existing linked entries sync hoti rahengi; cancel karne par reverse ho jayengi.
settings.requireDescriptionHint: Manual cashbook entries ke liye description dena compulsory hoga.
settings.allowBackdatedEntriesHint: Current Indian business day se pehle ki date par manual entries allow karein.
settings.invalidLimit: ₹0.01 aur ₹10,00,00,000 ke beech amount enter karein.
settings.openingHint: Is date ke liye actual cash in hand set karein. Yeh us din ka balance recalculate karke aage ke dino me carry karega.
settings.ownerOnly: Sirf store owner hi cashbook settings manage kar sakte hain.

day.title: Daily cash balances
day.carryHint: Bina activity wale dino me bhi cash aage carry forward hota hai. Timings Indian Standard Time (IST) me hain.
day.openHint: Opening cash pichle closing balance se carry forward hota hai. Business day aapke close karne tak midnight ke baad bhi open rahega.
day.noHistory: Abhi koi day action record nahi hua.

reconciliation.title: Cash reconcile karein
reconciliation.autoHint: Opening aur closing balances automatic hain. Roz day open ya close karne ki zaroorat nahi hai.
reconciliation.adjustmentHint: Haath mein actual cash daalein. Kami ya extra cash aapki wajah ke saath adjustment entry mein save hoga.
reconciliation.pendingHint: Cloud balances update karne aur cash reconcile karne ke liye pending changes sync karein.
